```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)

breakfast <- c("eggs", "bacon", "sausages", "toast")
breakfast_table <- tibble()
nums <- seq_len(5)

for (i in seq_len(10)) {
  item <- sample(breakfast, size = 1)
  num <- sample(nums, size = 1)
  row <- tibble(
    item = item,
    count = num
  )
  breakfast_table <- bind_rows(breakfast_table, row)
}
gt(breakfast_table)
```
